prompt:
You are the communication step of RiceBridge Ops, an irrigation agent for a 6-field rice cluster that shares one pump station in An Giang.

Deterministic tools have ALREADY computed the plan (water balance, crop-stage safety, pump capacity). You must not change any action, order, date or number. Your job:
1. headline_en / headline_vi: one sentence each that tells the pump-station manager what the plan does and the single most important reason, combining the events in INPUT.recent_events.
2. explain_en: 2-3 plain-English sentences for a non-expert audience on why the order is what it is (use the reasons given).
3. messages: one chat message per field in INPUT.rows (same fid), short (max 2 sentences), polite southern Vietnamese (anh/chị, nhé), plus English. Say clearly whether to open the inlet (and when HTX calls) or keep it closed and wait. For F3 (Bà Sáu, no smartphone) write the message to the HTX officer asking him to tell bà Sáu. If a row has measure_first true, ask HTX to measure that field before opening the inlet.

Hard constraint: every number you write must appear in INPUT (levels, dates, field numbers, mm). Do not invent yields, money, emissions or percentages.

Reply with ONE JSON object only, no prose, no code fence. It must match this JSON schema:
{"type": "object", "required": ["headline_en", "headline_vi", "explain_en", "messages"], "properties": {"headline_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 240}, "headline_vi": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 240}, "explain_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 600}, "messages": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["fid", "text_vi", "text_en"], "properties": {"fid": {"type": "string", "enum": ["F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F6"]}, "text_vi": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 260}, "text_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 300}}}}}}

data.headline_en: On Fri 06 Mar the pump opens F6 first, then F4 (after HTX measures it); F1, F2, F3 and F5 wait for the Tue 10 Mar run.
data.headline_vi: Lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar: mở cống F6 trước, rồi F4 (sau khi HTX đo lại); F1, F2, F3, F5 chờ đợt Tue 10 Mar.
data.explain_en: F6 goes first because its top-dressing window starts on Fri 06 Mar and the water would be at -4.9 cm without a refill. F4 is second: it starts flowering on Sat 07 Mar and its soil drains fast, but its last reading is old, so HTX should measure it before opening the inlet. The other four fields have enough water to last until the next run on Tue 10 Mar.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị thửa 6 ơi, lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar mình được mở cống đầu tiên nhé. HTX sẽ gọi khi tới lượt, vì nước dự kiến xuống -4.9 cm lúc bắt đầu bón thúc.
messages.text_en: Field 6: you are first in the Fri 06 Mar run, so please open the inlet when HTX calls. Without water the level would drop to -4.9 cm as top-dressing starts.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị thửa 4 ơi, mình là thứ 2 trong lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar nhé. HTX sẽ đo ruộng mình trước, rồi gọi để mở cống, vì số đo lần cuối đã cũ rồi.
messages.text_en: Field 4: you are second in the Fri 06 Mar run. HTX will measure your field first, then call you to open the inlet, because the last reading is old.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị thửa 1 ơi, lượt này mình chưa cần mở cống, cứ giữ nước và chờ đợt bơm Tue 10 Mar nhé.
messages.text_en: Field 1: no need to open the inlet this run. Keep the water and wait for the Tue 10 Mar run.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị thửa 2 ơi, lượt này mình giữ cống đóng và chờ đợt bơm Tue 10 Mar nhé. HTX sẽ báo khi tới lượt.
messages.text_en: Field 2: keep the inlet closed this run and wait for the Tue 10 Mar run. HTX will let you know when it is your turn.

messages.text_vi: Anh cán bộ HTX ơi, nhờ anh báo bà Sáu giúp là lượt này chưa mở cống, cứ giữ nước và chờ đợt bơm Tue 10 Mar nhé.
messages.text_en: HTX officer: please tell bà Sáu that her field does not open the inlet this run. She should keep the water and wait for the Tue 10 Mar run.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị thửa 5 ơi, lượt này mình chưa mở cống, cứ giữ nước và chờ đợt bơm Tue 10 Mar nhé.
messages.text_en: Field 5: do not open the inlet this run. Keep the water and wait for the Tue 10 Mar run.
